sys_hub_flow.description:
Transcribes speech to text

Inputs:

  • Audio File Sys ID - The Sys ID of the audio file.
  • Format - Specifies the result format. Accepted values are simple and detailed.
  • Profanity - Specifies how to handle profanity in recognition results. Accepted values are: masked, removed, raw.
  • Language - Identifies the spoken language that's being recognized

Outputs:

  • Display Text - The transcribed text.
  • Offset - The time (in 100-nanosecond units) at which the recognized speech begins in the audio stream.
  • Recognition Status - Status, such as Success for successful recognition.
  • Duration - The duration (in 100-nanosecond units) of the recognized speech in the audio stream.
  • NBest - An array of NBest objects of the transcription
  • Action Status - An object with the following fields:
    • Code - If the request is executed successfully, code will be set to 0 but if the request failed, code will be set to 1.
    • Message - Reason for error. Populated only when an error occurs.

To use this action, the corresponding connection and credential must be created and associated with the Microsoft Azure AI Speech Connection & Credential Alias.

Note: Requires a subscription for production use. Read More.
